page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled, providing dedicated physical execution resources for each vCPU. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density position this instance as a robust option for workloads requiring predictable compute performance and large memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading, though the lack of bundled local storage is a key architectural tradeoff to consider.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.r8i.12xlarge is suited for memory-intensive enterprise applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and data processing workloads that demand dedicated CPU cores and substantial RAM capacity.
